scripts.prebuild: python3 scripts/gen_math_names.py && python3 scripts/subset_fonts.py && python3 scripts/check_ligatures.py && node scripts/check_error_art.mjs
scripts.build: astro build && npx pagefind --site dist && node scripts/postprocess.mjs dist --gates
scripts.verify:embeds: rm -rf dist-verify && INCLUDE_DRAFTS=1 astro build --outDir dist-verify && (node scripts/check_embeds.mjs dist-verify; ec=$?; rm -rf dist-verify; exit $ec)
scripts.preview:build: python3 scripts/subset_fonts.py --include-drafts && rm -rf dist-preview-stage && INCLUDE_DRAFTS=1 PORTAL_ORIGIN=${PORTAL_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8088/} astro build --outDir dist-preview-stage && npx pagefind --site dist-preview-stage && node scripts/postprocess.mjs dist-preview-stage --spelling && mkdir -p dist-preview && rsync -a --delete-delay dist-preview-stage/ dist-preview/
